questionText:
Consider the following sentences:

(i) Everybody in the class is prepared for the exam.
(ii) Babu invited Danish to his home because he enjoys playing chess.

Which of the following is the CORRECT observation about the above two sentences?
options: (i) is grammatically correct and (ii) is unambiguous
(i) is grammatically incorrect and (ii) is unambiguous
(i) is grammatically correct and (ii) is ambiguous
(i) is grammatically incorrect and (ii) is ambiguous
explanation:
Sentence (i): "Everybody in the class is prepared for the exam."
The subject "Everybody" is an indefinite singular pronoun, which correctly agrees with the singular verb "is". Therefore, sentence (i) is grammatically correct.

Sentence (ii): "Babu invited Danish to his home because he enjoys playing chess."
The pronoun "he" is pronoun-referent ambiguous because it is unclear whether "he" refers to Babu or Danish. Therefore, sentence (ii) is ambiguous.

Hence, option (C) is the correct observation.
